knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The worked example records a closed restroom as not cleaned and adds the access restriction. The procedure says never to mark tasks complete without checking them.
If access, consent or authority is unclear, the affected work is paused and the gap is recorded and escalated. Tasks without checks are never marked complete.
The workplace procedure says to record completed work, exclusions, access restrictions, defects, incidents, consumables and follow-up requests.

practicalCriteria: Reports truthfully, verifies work, secures the site and assigns unresolved items for follow-up.
Recognises and escalates unsafe or out-of-scope work
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Reinspect completed zones against the actual contract checklist.
Record of procedure step 2: Record completed work, exclusions, access restrictions, defects, incidents, consumables and follow-up requests.
Record of procedure step 3: Separate an observed defect from a suspected cause in the record.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Hand unresolved hazards directly to the appropriate supervisor.
Stop work if procedure step 7 is not done: Do not mark any task as complete without checking it.
